縦 113mm　　横 38.2mm　　厚さ 37.5mm　（突起部分を除く）
コントロールスティック

notes: Nintendo JP Wii controllers page, spec modal nunchukDetail.html, product code [RVL-004]. Axis mapping as labelled: 縦 113mm = height, 横 38.2mm = width, 厚さ 37.5mm = depth, 突起部分を除く → excludes_projections true. 操作部: 3-axis motion sensor, Ｃ・Ｚ buttons, control stick → face_button 2 (C and Z; the page gives no placement — Z is the front trigger, but that is not sourced here), stick 1. The Nunchuk is an extension controller: «Wiiリモコン、Wiiリモコンプラスの外部拡張コネクタにつなげて使用します» (controllers page) and it uses the Remote's communication. It connects to the REMOTE, not the console, by a cord — Nintendo's text says «つなげて» (connect) without naming a cable, so wired, ports and cable_length_mm are left null/[] (wired here would mean a cord to the console). No battery (none mentioned; cell_kind null). released = white model 発売日 from the controllers page alt text; host_console from its title. Mass and cord: Nintendo JP Wii setup manual (wiimanual_setup.pdf), spec table for ヌンチャク [RVL-004], PDFKit text: 外形寸法 «横38.2mm×縦113mm×厚さ37.5mm» (agrees with the web modal; no conflict), then the labels コードの長さ and 質量 followed by the values «90cm» and «約73g» in that order → mass_g 73 (the manual does not say what the mass includes; the cord is part of the unit). The cord length is printed as 90cm, in centimetres, so cable_length_mm stays null (no conversions); the cord runs to the Wii Remote's extension connector, not to the console, which is why wired stays null too.
